synthetic_host.effective_device: CPU; no inflated or inferred GPU timings

projection_conservative_not_measurement.checkpoint_breakdown: 36 primary runs x4 doublings=144; 4 extra independent finalist starts x4=16; 10 finalists x3 further doublings=30; 36 frozen controls x4=144. Earlier plateau or overfit can shorten this.
projection_conservative_not_measurement.limitation: fit scoring may cost differently; CPU raw data, H100 host, file system, inputs, frozen crystal cut computation, JSON and result transfer differ. This is a scale check, not a remote timing. Source verification, support construction, transfer, CV scoring, outputs and queue/cleanup are billed within the actual sandbox wall cap. No output/job retries.

artifacts: Each completed depth writes a private portable NPZ, optional continuation moments and a final atomic hard-linked learning JSON (publication barrier). No checkpoint counts until the optimizer has actually stepped, every reported symbol exposure counts a real training positive. Main may collect already-finished files while the sandbox is still alive. No TEST.
